assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: pixel-art animation sprite sheet, EXACTLY 4 columns by 2 rows, eight separate equal cells, transparent background. Image 1 is identity reference: use ONLY Leo, the curly dark-haired teenage boy with goggles on forehead, olive green work jacket, white shirt, blue jeans, tool belt and sneakers. All poses face RIGHT, fully visible, consistent head/body size and a common feet baseline near the bottom of every cell, no overlap. Row1 four distinct sprint animation phases: left-leg extended contact with right leg back and opposite arms; right knee forward passing with left leg planted; right-leg extended contact with left leg back; left knee forward passing with right leg planted. Energetic believable sprint, different limb positions and darker far leg. Row2 col1 duck-running low with knees bent and head/torso nearly horizontal, col2 opposite low duck-running step; col3 compact airborne jump pose with knees tucked, arms balancing; col4 standing alert side view. Duck poses are HALF the height of standing poses, aligned to the same foot baseline, DO NOT enlarge them. No sword, hammer or carried weapon. Crisp detailed pixel art matching reference. True transparent alpha, no scenery, no text, no grid lines, no painted shadows or glow. Keep wide padding between cells.
